quotes.text: “Now, O Lord! thy servant has been obedient to the heavenly vision which thou gavest him in his native land; and
The Hebrew words translated "Whither have ye made a road to day?" could have been translated "Have you not attacked today?
quotes.speaker: Daniel H. Ludlow
quotes.source: A Companion to Your Study of the Old Testament [Salt Lake City: Deseret Book Co.
